about_short_description.short_description: Myria is a blockchain gaming platform that combines a gaming platform with applications, tools, and scaling infrastructure.

product.name: Myria SDK
product.description: A software development kit that enables game studios to build blockchain-based games using Myria's Layer 2 protocol with simplified blockchain integration via REST APIs.

product.name: MYRIA Token
product.description: An ERC-20 utility token used for transactions, staking, governance, and in-game utility within the Myria Web3 gaming ecosystem.

product.name: Myria Nodes
product.description: Network nodes operated by users that secure the Myria blockchain, participate in governance, and earn MYRIA token rewards.

product.name: Myria Developer Grant Program
product.description: A funding and support program that provides financial grants and advisory services to teams developing Web3 games on Myria's platform.
